p01.sspecial: dashes forward very low and fast, then spins around on the spot and swings his elbow back behind him, then turns back into the stance; nothing leaves his body, his hands stay empty
p01.uair: in mid-air, sweeps one open hand up in an arc over his head, then back to the tucked pose; nothing leaves his body, his hands stay empty
p01.dair: in mid-air, extends one leg straight down below him heel first, then pulls the leg back up; nothing leaves his body
p01.fsmash: silat double palm push: sinks low drawing both hands back to the hip, then steps forward and pushes both open palms straight ahead at chest height, then recovers; nothing leaves his hands, his hands stay empty
p01.grab: lunges forward and reaches out with both open hands, closes them on empty air, then pulls back; nothing leaves his hands
p01.fthrow: holding an invisible opponent, steps forward and pushes both hands forward, then returns to the fighting stance. Only the character is drawn: the opponent is invisible, there is no other person in the frame; nothing leaves his hands
p01.bthrow: pivots on the spot, turning his back to the right for a moment with both arms swinging close to his body, then turns back into the fighting stance. Only the character is drawn: the opponent is invisible, there is no other person in the frame; his hands stay empty, nothing leaves them, no beam, no streak
p01.dthrow: holding an invisible opponent, crouches and brings both hands down to the floor in front of him, then rises back into the fighting stance. Only the character is drawn: the opponent is invisible, there is no other person in the frame; nothing leaves his hands
p01.w1_dthrow: holding an invisible opponent, crouches and brings his free hand down to the floor in front of him, then points both curved violet daggers down at the floor, then returns to the ready stance. Only the character is drawn: the opponent is invisible, there is no other person in the frame; nothing comes out of the floor or the daggers
p01.w1_dspecial: slowly lowers onto one knee with the two curved violet daggers held still at his sides, then slowly stands back up into the stance

p02.knockdown: tips slowly backwards off balance and sinks down until she lies flat on her back on the floor, ending lying still; nothing else is drawn around her
p02.ledgeattack: rises from a low crouch with a quick low sweeping kick forward, then back into the fighting stance; her foot passes just above the floor, nothing is kicked up
p02.w0_knockdown: tips slowly backwards off balance and sinks down until she lies flat on her back on the floor, still holding her spear, ending lying still; nothing else is drawn around her
p02.w0_grab: leans forward and reaches out with her free open hand, closes it on empty air, then pulls back, the other hand keeping a long silver spear with white ribbons still at her side. The whole weapon stays inside the picture; nothing leaves her hands
p02.w0_sspecial: runs forward with the spear held out in front, then slows down and stops in the stance; her feet stay light on the floor, nothing is kicked up
p02.w0_dthrow: holding an invisible opponent low with her free hand, raises the long spear above her head, then brings it down slowly in front of her, the whole spear always drawn clearly, then returns to the ready stance. Only the character is drawn: the opponent is invisible, there is no other person in the frame
p02.w1_holdstart: keeps a staff topped by a blue crystal star with ribbons upright in the hand on her right side and stretches her other arm straight out to the right at shoulder height, across in front of her chest, the open hand closing on the collar of an invisible opponent standing to her right; ends with that arm fully extended to the right, holding it at arm's length, staying in side profile facing right the whole time. Only the character is drawn: the opponent is invisible, there is no other person in the frame
p02.w1_jab: a short quick swing of the star staff forward at chest height, the staff head staying well inside the picture, then back into the stance
p02.w1_nspecial: raises the staff slightly in front of her, holds it, then lowers it back into the stance; the star-shaped head of the staff stays plain
p02.w1_dspecial: holds the staff upright in front of her with both hands and stays still a moment, then lowers it back into the stance; nothing on the staff shines
p02.w1_jab2: turns the staff over in a small backhand motion in front of her chest, then back into the stance; the star-shaped head of the staff stays plain

p03.dspecial: crouches and presses both fists down onto the floor in front of him, then stands back up; nothing comes out of the floor or his fists
p03.dair: in mid-air, brings both elbows down beneath him, then back to the tucked pose; nothing is drawn below him
p03.w0_fthrow: pushes the invisible opponent he is holding forward with his free hand, then swings a huge jagged black greatsword with glowing red veins in a wide arc in front of him, the whole blade always drawn clearly, then returns to the ready stance. Only the character is drawn: the opponent is invisible, there is no other person in the frame
p03.w0_getup: gets up from lying on his back: rolls onto his feet and stands back up into the ready stance, a huge jagged black greatsword with red veins in hand, the blade drawn plainly, no shine on it. The whole weapon stays inside the picture
p03.w1_crouch: crouches down low on the spot and holds it: knees fully bent, hips dropped onto the heels, torso folded forward, head ducked low at about half his standing height, a huge spiked black and red greatsword, larger and more jagged resting still on his shoulder the whole time
p03.w1_land: standing on the floor, bends the knees deeply as if just landed, then rises back into the stance, a huge spiked black and red greatsword, larger and more jagged resting still on his shoulder the whole time; the feet stay on the floor
p03.w1_roll: dodge roll: tucks into a tight ball and rolls forward, a huge spiked black and red greatsword, larger and more jagged held flat against his back the whole time, then springs back up into the same stance. The whole weapon stays inside the picture
p03.w1_airdodge: air dodge: curls up tightly in mid-air in the same place, a huge spiked black and red greatsword, larger and more jagged held still against his body, the body staying in the middle of the picture, then opens up again in the same pose
p03.w1_pummel: taps the invisible opponent he is holding with the pommel of a huge spiked black and red greatsword, larger and more jagged: a small short motion of the hilt, then back to holding. Only the character is drawn: the opponent is invisible, there is no other person in the frame
p03.w1_dthrow: bends his knees and slowly lowers the invisible opponent he is holding with his free hand, a huge spiked black and red greatsword, larger and more jagged resting still on his shoulder the whole time, then straightens back up into the ready stance. Only the character is drawn: the opponent is invisible, there is no other person in the frame
p03.w1_fthrow: pushes the invisible opponent he is holding forward with his free hand, a huge spiked black and red greatsword, larger and more jagged resting still on his shoulder, then returns to the ready stance. Only the character is drawn: the opponent is invisible, there is no other person in the frame
p03.w1_jab3: a short straight thrust of the spiked greatsword forward at chest height, the blade staying well inside the picture, then back into the stance

p07.dash: leans the torso far forward and takes one long low step to the right from the stance, both arms swept back, ending on the front foot in a running pose
p07.dashattack: standing in a long low front stance, drives a straight punch far forward with her right arm fully extended, holds the punch, then pulls back into the stance; the feet stay planted
p07.hurt: flinches backwards in pain: head thrown back, body leaning backwards, arms raised, then holds that pained pose
p07.nair: in mid-air, spins once with both legs extended, then tucks again, staying high in the air the whole time, the feet never touching anything
p07.uair: in mid-air, raises one arm straight above her head with the hand open, then lowers it back to the tucked pose; her colours stay the same
p07.dair: in mid-air, extends one leg straight down below her with the heel pointing down, then pulls the leg back to the tucked pose
p07.dtilt: karate foot sweep: drops low on one knee and swings the front foot in a low arc just above the floor, then rises into the stance
p07.usmash: karate rising palm strike: standing still with both feet on the floor, pushes one open palm straight up above her head, then lowers it back into the stance
p07.bthrow: holding an invisible opponent, turns her body around and pushes both open hands behind her, then returns to the fighting stance. Only the character is drawn: the opponent is invisible, there is no other person in the frame
p07.ledgeattack: rises from a crouch and kicks one leg forward at knee height, then back into the fighting stance
p07.sspecial: leans forward and takes one long step, raising one knee high in front of her, then lowers it back into the stance; her colours stay the same
p07.w0_jab3: a short straight thrust of the sword forward at chest height, the blade staying well inside the picture, then back into the stance
p07.w0_sspecial: leans her whole body forward and extends the sword far ahead with both hands, the feet staying planted, then pulls back into the stance
p07.w1_dspecial: lowers the jagged sword point-down in front of her and holds it there a moment, then raises it back into the stance
p07.w1_jab3: a short straight thrust of the jagged sword forward at chest height, the blade staying well inside the picture, then back into the stance
p07.w1_roll: dodge roll: tucks into a tight ball and rolls forward, the broad black and red sword held flat against her back the whole time, then springs back up into the same stance. The whole weapon stays inside the picture
p07.w0_ultimate: steps forward three times, swinging the sword in a wide arc at each step, then stops with her back turned and the sword lowered
p07.w1_ultimate: steps forward three times, swinging the jagged sword in a wide arc at each step, then stops with her back turned and the sword lowered
p07.w0_bthrow: holding an invisible opponent with her free hand, turns her body around and pushes that hand behind her, the sword held still in the other hand, then returns to the ready stance. Only the character is drawn: the opponent is invisible, there is no other person in the frame
p07.w0_nair: in mid-air, turns once on herself holding the sword out to the side, the blade staying inside the picture, then tucks again

p08.usmash: kung fu crescent kick: standing on one leg, swings the other leg in a high arc above his head, then lowers it back into the stance, the standing foot stays planted; nothing flashes where the foot passes
p08.nspecial: pushes one open palm forward at chest height, then pulls it back into the stance
p08.roll: curls up into a ball and somersaults forward once, his white coat wrapped around him, then stands back up into the same stance
p08.w0_jab: a short straight thrust of the sword forward at chest height, the blade staying well inside the picture, then back into the stance
p08.w0_uspecial: rises turning once on himself with the sword held out to the side, the blade staying inside the picture, then ends in the air
p08.w0_sspecial: leans his whole body forward and extends the sword far ahead with one arm, the feet staying planted, then pulls back into the stance
p08.w0_dspecial: holds the sword vertical in front of him as a guard and stays still a moment, then swings it down in a short cut, the blade staying inside the picture
p08.w1_dash: leans the torso far forward and takes one long low step to the right from the stance, the halberd held low behind him, ending on the front foot in a running pose
p08.w0_ultimate: raises the sword high above his head and holds it a moment, then brings it down in one wide arc in front of him, the blade staying inside the picture, then lowers it back into the stance; the feet stay planted
p08.w1_jab: a short straight thrust of the golden halberd forward at chest height, the blade staying well inside the picture, then back into the stance; his colours stay the same
p08.w1_roll: dodge roll: tucks into a tight ball in the middle of the picture and rolls forward, the halberd held flat against his back, then springs back up into the same stance; the whole body and the halberd stay inside the picture
p08.w1_grab: leans forward and slowly reaches out with his free open hand, closes it, then pulls back, the other hand keeping the golden halberd still at his side; nothing shines
p08.w1_getup: gets up from lying on his back: rolls onto his feet and stands back up into the ready stance, the golden halberd held still in hand; nothing on the halberd shines
p08.nair: in mid-air, extends both legs out in a split, then tucks again, staying high in the air the whole time, the feet never touching anything
p08.bair: in mid-air, pushes one open palm straight out behind him, then back to the tucked pose, staying high in the air, nothing below him
p08.fair: in mid-air, extends one leg straight forward, then pulls the leg back, staying high in the air, nothing below him
p08.w1_nspecial: draws the golden halberd back and thrusts it forward at arm's length as if throwing a javelin, without letting go, then pulls it back into the stance
p08.w1_sspecial: leans forward low with the golden halberd held out in front, takes one long step forward, then stops with the feet planted
p08.w1_uspecial: swings the golden halberd in a rising arc above his head while rising on his toes, then ends holding it raised
p08.w1_bthrow: holding an invisible opponent with his free hand, turns his body around and pushes that hand behind him, the golden halberd held still in the other hand, then returns to the ready stance; nothing shines. Only the character is drawn: the opponent is invisible, there is no other person in the frame
p08.w1_dthrow: bends forward and slowly lowers the invisible opponent he is holding with his free hand, the golden halberd held still at his side, then straightens back up into the ready stance; nothing shines, nothing appears around him. Only the character is drawn: the opponent is invisible, there is no other person in the frame
p08.dair: in mid-air, lowers both open hands in front of his chest, then back to the tucked pose, staying high in the air; nothing below him
p08.w1_dspecial: plants the golden halberd upright beside him and leans on it for a moment, then lifts it back into the stance; nothing shines
p08.w1_ultimate: raises the golden halberd high above his head with both hands and holds it, then sweeps it down in one wide arc in front of him, the blade staying inside the picture, then lowers it back into the stance; the feet stay planted
p08.fthrow: holding an invisible opponent, steps forward and slowly pushes both open hands forward at chest height, then returns to the fighting stance; nothing shines. Only the character is drawn: the opponent is invisible, there is no other person in the frame
p08.w1_jab2: a wide horizontal sweep of the golden halberd in front of him, the blade staying inside the picture, then back into the stance; nothing shines
